problem: Users often need external applications to view or modify non-Markdown files like spreadsheets, presentations, or source code within their notes.
summary: Vault Lens allows users to preview, zoom, edit, and save various document types, including Office files (docx, xlsx, pptx) and over 60 code formats, directly within the Obsidian editor.
